reviews.text: Trust is the most important aspect when caring for your pet.   Nothing else matters.

I have been going here for years
First with my lab then with my 2 cats they are so attentive Dr Belovitch is great as well as all the other vets great job !
They always take good care of my puppy

We had a really positive experience with Yonge Street Animal Hospital while getting our cat assessed for some dental issues. The vet took the time to thoroughly examine him, explain what they found, and walk us through what to expect with his upcoming dental procedure and potential extractions.

Everyone we interacted with was kind, professional, and reassuring, which made an understandably stressful situation much easier. I also really appreciated how accommodating and compassionate the clinic was when we discussed the cost of his upcoming treatment. They were very understanding and worked with us to arrange payment installments, taking away a lot of the financial stress and allowing us to focus on getting Tobie the care he needs.

We really appreciate the care they've shown Tobie and the kindness they've shown us throughout the process. ❤️

We have consistently had an excellent experience with Dr. Eisen and the entire team at Yonge Street Animal Hospital. Beyond the quality of their veterinary care, their customer service is exceptional.
The staff regularly help us with our pet insurance claims and make the process much easier. When our insurance provider denied coverage, Dr. Eisen and the team promptly prepared a detailed technical letter containing everything we needed to appeal the decision. Their responsiveness and willingness to support us went far beyond what we expected.
They are also very flexible when scheduling appointments, and their communication by email is always fast, clear, and reliable. We especially appreciate that they dedicate one day each week to cats only, which helps create a calmer and less stressful experience for feline patients.
When we had to say goodbye to our beloved cat, Popcorn, Dr. Eisen cared for her with compassion and dignity while giving us honest, direct guidance. The beautiful handwritten sympathy card the team sent afterward was incredibly thoughtful.
We trust Dr. Eisen and the Yonge Street Animal Hospital team completely and will continue bringing our other cat, Pancake, to them for all of her veterinary needs. It is difficult to find a clinic that combines excellent medical care, compassion, responsiveness, and outstanding customer service so consistently. We wholeheartedly recommend them.
